notes.title: Version 1.2: The "Quality of life" update!
notes.notes:
This update (by far the biggest so far) for Dagdrøm contains 200+ quality of life improvements, some big, some small! The biggest news is probably a Linux build, but there are new animations, a new hint book, new menus and 75+ changed dialogue options for making the game more intuitive.

I also made a new (and improved) walkthrough for the game which is available in the forums . Read below for a complete list of fixes and improvements.

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43089508/6fc8faaa7a9e314f50c481113a72334dc354abea.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43089508/1b92300f105a63cf69b913dcdffbec9b09d4a945.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43089508/070fb5fe2639a7630a4dc0f20da5ff298c376a83.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43089508/b23f545af8279613731e6a94f178368cdbe4522d.png[/img][/url]
[i]Pictured above: New menu design & hint book[/i]

[b]General:[/b]
[list]
[*] Linux build!
[*] Hint book that you can toggle on or off added (replaced the visual walkthrough)
[*] Added missing highlights on mouse over some hotspots
[*] Set visible audio hints ON as default
[*] Improved 10+ speaker hints to make them less obtuse
[*] Complete redesign of pause, controls and options menus
[*] Performance improvements
[*] Moved Tarot deck to pause menu for simplification
[*] Interface adjustments (primarily for Steam Deck)
[*] Fixed bug causing player to some times walk out of playable area on load
[/list]
[b]Act 1:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added visual improvements to The Moon Flower Pot on The Roof Terrace, for clarification
[*] Clarified directions to The Travel Agent on new game
[*] Replaced arbirtrary quick travel to some locations with new quick travel map inventory item
[*] Added visual improvements to zone selector in The Common Area, for clarification
[*] Streamlined tutorial on new game
[*] The Robot Librarian now gives you clearer hints regarding The Third Book Slip
[*] Clarified the breakdown of The Ticket Machine further
[*] Replaced 75+ dialogue options on NPCs with clearer hints for progress
[*] Fixed faulty scene transition fade-out
[/list]
[b]Act 2:[/b]
[list]
[*] Clarified "The Bird Puzzle" with some visual improvements to The Zoologists Tower
[*] Rare camera bug fixed in The Plaza
[*] Added visual improvements to The Travel Guide instructions for making broth (salted water)
[*] Quick fix for weird bug some times causing a black screen (but still interactability) on The Lake location
[/list]
[b]Act 3:[/b]
[list]
[*] Simplified puzzles on floor V of The Trial Foors
[*] Fixed superficial loading bugs when backtracking on a specific floor of The Trial Floors
[/list]

notes.title: Release date the 19th of May + five days left of beta testing!
notes.notes:
An official release date for Dagdrøm is finally ready: If everything goes as planned the game will be released the 19th of May 2023 on Steam! Improvements at this points are mostly fixing bugs, implementing the soudntrack and correcting some bad filters (color grading).

In other news: Over 100 testers has gotten their access to the beta version of the game, but I still need more feedback! If you have played it, but haven't submitted any feedback yet you can do it [url=https://forms.gle/oLTQKX7xBNYeqybt6]here[/url].

notes.title: Beta testing now open!
notes.notes:
[i]Dagdrøm[/i], a new point-and-click adventure, coming later this year, is now ready for beta testing. The game is in a decent state, but with some key elements missing:

[list]
[*]Soundtrack (some sketches are in, but nothing final)
[*]Color grading (some coloring, especially in night scenes, is temporary)
[*]The ending is lacking in audio effects
[*]Credit scene (missing)
[*]Norwegian translation missing (bokmål and nynorsk)
[/list]

Other than that, it is close! If you want to help out (and get credit in the credit scene), I would be really grateful! Ask for permission to join the beta, and you will get it.

Here is [url=https://forms.gle/QsnCmpT8CuaQehip9]the feedback survey (Google Forms)[/url]

Happy playing!
